title: Operations Manager - I, EasyShip
description:

title: AD/Lead Consultant- Data Strategy and Operations
description:
At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it’s work worth doing. If you’re driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us.
  
  
Company Overview
  
At Lilly, we unite caring with discovery to make life better for people around the world. We are a global healthcare leader headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana. Our employees work to discover and bring life-changing medicines to those who need them, improve disease management, and give back to our communities through philanthropy and volunteerism. We bring our best to our work — and we put people first. We’re looking for individuals who are determined to make life better for people around the world.
  
Responsibilities
  
The GOSO Data Strategy & AI Lead will report to the GOSO DSO Lead and play a critical role in defining and operationalizing GOSO’s centralized data and AI strategy. This role will architect the AI-ready data foundation required for agentic AI systems, machine learning pipelines, and advanced analytics across GOSO — with particular attention to the complexity and scale of US and International Business Unit (IBU) markets, affiliate data ecosystems, and cross-market harmonization challenges. This role will also lead and mentor a small team — developing talent across data engineering, applied ML, and AI operations.
  
Key Accountabilities
  
  

* Define and operationalize the GOSO-wide data and AI strategy in partnership with Tech@Lilly and GOSO Functional Teams (SFO, IC, DT), ensuring the platform supports next-generation AI/ML workloads including agentic AI, RAG, and semantic reasoning layers — while accounting for IBU-specific multi-market data heterogeneity and varying data maturity across geographies.
* Translate functional and business requirements into scalable Data Spine implementations on AWS/Databricks that support feature stores, semantic layers, and data contracts required by downstream ML and agentic AI systems — designing for IBU scalability with repeatable, templatized onboarding of new affiliate markets without bespoke rework.
* Architect data structures, semantic ontologies, and API-accessible data services that enable agentic AI capabilities — prioritizing use cases that address IBU-specific pain points like multi-market reconciliation and cross-geography performance benchmarking.
* Drive the design and deployment of production ML pipelines — from feature engineering and model training through deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement — establishing MLOps patterns (experiment tracking, model versioning, drift detection, automated retraining) that scale across both HQ and IBU workloads.
* Lead the design of multi-agent architectures where specialized AI agents operate within an orchestrated ecosystem with well-defined tool-use patterns, memory management, and human-in-the-loop escalation — ensuring agent designs are adaptable to US/IBU contexts where business rules and decision thresholds vary by market.
* Serve as the primary point of contact for T@L on all data and AI-related initiatives, ensuring aligned priorities, transparent execution, and a unified roadmap that accounts for platform evolution, emerging AI capabilities, and enterprise MLOps standards — while representing IBU requirements in enterprise-level planning.
* Drive AI literacy and adoption enablement across GOSO functional stakeholders — including IBU affiliate teams where AI readiness may vary significantly — ensuring predictable onboarding of new data assets, ML models, and agentic workflows into the GOSO ecosystem.
* Identify opportunities to reduce manual interventions and accelerate insight generation through ML-driven data quality monitoring, self-healing pipelines, and intelligent automation — with particular focus on eliminating repetitive market-by-market manual processes common in US/IBU operations.
* Develop, mentor, and coach a small team of analysts, data engineers, and AI practitioners — ensuring capability development across data engineering, applied ML, and AI operations, with cross-functional exposure to data and AI domains.

Basic Qualifications / Technical Skills
  
  

* Bachelor’s Degree (preferably in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, AI/ML, or related fields); advanced degree preferred.
* 10+ years of experience in pharmaceutical commercial data engineering, data platforms, analytics ecosystems, and/or applied AI/ML.
* Strong understanding of cloud-based data architectures and pharma commercial ecosystems — with a clear grasp of how data foundations enable ML and agentic AI at scale.
* Practical experience with Databricks (including Unity Catalog, MLflow, Feature Store, and/or Agent Bricks), AWS services (S3, EC2, RDS, Redshift), and modern data engineering/AI best practices.
* Expertise in SQL; proficiency in Python (including ML libraries such as scikit-learn, PyTorch, or LangChain/LangGraph for agentic frameworks).
* Strong understanding of ETL/ELT processes, semantic layer design, and experience with orchestration platforms such as AWS Glue or Databricks workflows.
* Hands-on MLOps experience — model versioning, experiment tracking, deployment pipelines, monitoring, and drift detection.
* Experience designing or deploying agentic AI systems, multi-agent orchestration, or tool-use agent architectures in a production or near-production setting.
* Ability to quickly assess upstream/downstream impacts for data, model, and system changes across interconnected analytics and AI workloads.
* Strong stakeholder management and prior experience operating in a matrixed global environment.

Additional Skills / Preferences
  
  
**IBU / International Commercial Domain (Strongly Preferred):**  

* Prior experience with International Business Unit or multi-affiliate pharma commercial operations — understanding of how data flows, vendor ecosystems, and commercial models differ across US and ex-US markets (Japan, Europe, Emerging Markets).
* Familiarity with IBU-specific data challenges: multi-vendor sourcing (IQVIA, local vendors), cross-country definition variability, affiliate-level sales/demand structures and market-specific compliance requirements.
* Experience with IBU/US commercial analytics domains such as incentive compensation, sales force operations, dynamic targeting, or demand forecasting in a multi-market context.
* Understanding of global vs. local data ownership models in a matrixed IBU environment — and how to design AI systems that respect affiliate context while enabling centralized intelligence

We deliver on that mission through a unique manufacturer-to-consumer (M2C) model eliminating the layers of traditional retail that add cost and result in consumers paying more than they need to. We find, build relationships with, and work directly with the manufacturing partners behind some of the world's finest products. From there, our teams design smart, efficient operational processes and build and deploy proprietary technology, AI, and analytics to help us scale fast.

What began with a small assortment of elevated basics has quickly grown into a cross-category brand spanning apparel, accessories, home goods, and more. Today, tens of millions of people across a growing number of countries come – and return – to Quince because they trust us to deliver.

**OUR CULTURE**

Quince is a culture built for builders by builders. Our way of working starts with a blank sheet of paper. We question conventional thinking, use technology and data to uncover new opportunities, and move quickly to turn ideas into reality. We aren't interested in replicating how others do retail. We're building a better way – at a speed and scale unlike anything that's been done before.

* We dream big and chase the hard problems others shy away from. Rejecting long-held assumptions is part of our company's DNA. Where conventional wisdom says you have to choose – soft or durable, speed or rigor, quality or price – we ask why that trade-off has to exist in the first place.

* Here, responsibility is not determined by role, tenure, or seniority. Every team member - no matter their level - has the opportunity to drive our business and shape our trajectory.

If you're someone who likes to imagine new possibilities and build better systems rather than plug-in to outdated ones, Quince is the place for you.

**JOB TITLE****:**

**Manager. Material Production - Leather**

RESPONSIBILITIES:

Leather Inventory & Quality Control

* Oversee leather inventory levels to ensure adequate supply for tanning schedules while minimizing waste and overstock.
* Inspect and verify that only quality leather—meeting specified micron, length, and color consistency standards—is released into the tanning process.
* Implement checkpoints to catch non-conforming leather before production begins, preventing downstream defects.
* Coordinate with sourcing and warehouse teams to maintain accurate inventory records and proper storage conditions for raw leather.

  

On-Time Delivery (OTD) Management

* Own leather OTD performance, tracking delivery timelines from suppliers to tanneries and flagging potential delays.
* Proleatherly manage production schedules to ensure leather is available when needed, communicating risks to cross-functional partners.
* Resolve supply interruptions by expediting shipments or reallocating inventory as necessary to meet production deadlines.
* Establish and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) for supplier lead times and delivery reliability.

  

Tanning & Production Support

* Partner with tanneries to ensure leather lots are processed according to technical specifications and quality expectations.

title: Senior Revenue Operations Manager
description:
**Company Description**

BlueOptima is the global reference for Software Engineering Intelligence. We provide an AI Trust Layer for Enterprise Code, enabling large organizations to prove ROI, reduce risk, and confidently scale AI deployment. Our objective metrics help businesses transform engineering from a cost center to a value creator.

We are a team of around 110 people across the UK, US, India, Mexico, Japan and Canada and we work closely across teams and time zones. People here are given real ownership early and the autonomy to run with it. If you like seeing your work change how a company operates, you will feel at home.

 **Job Description**

BlueOptima is investing in Revenue Operations, and we want an experienced RevOps leader to build the function and own it. The vision is simple: one CRM the whole business trusts, a forecast that calls the quarter early, and a revenue engine designed on purpose. You are a builder who has run forecasting and CRM design before and wants ownership and autonomy. The role is based in London on a hybrid pattern.

As **Senior Revenue Operations Manager** you will work on and develop the systems, data and processes behind BlueOptima’s revenue: the CRM, the forecast, enablement, the deal desk and the planning behind targets and pay. You will report to our Head of Finance & Operations, giving you an independent view of the numbers, and work day to day with our CRO. Our customers rely on BlueOptima for objective measurement of their engineering, and this role brings the same objectivity to how we measure and grow our own business.

**Our Product Portfolio: (Platform Insights, Code Insights, Predictive Assessment, Active Multisite)**

BlueOptima is a multi-product business. Platform Insights gives engineering leaders objective measures of productivity, quality and cost across their teams, vendors and AI tools. Code Insights finds vulnerabilities, exposed secrets and AI-authored code before release. Predictive Assessment helps companies hire developers on measured coding performance. Our Active MultiSite suite (SVN Multisite, Git Multisite, Gerrit Multisite and Access Control Plus) ensures high availability, performance and security for distributed development teams, and is trusted by leading global organizations to manage their critical source code and infrastructure.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Roadmap:** Develop the RevOps roadmap, priorities and team, and run a fixed rhythm with the CRO: weekly forecast, monthly revenue review and quarterly business review.
* **CRM:** Make our CRM the single system of record for customers, pipeline and contracts, and own its data model, integrations, automation and change control.
* **Govern revenue data:** Agree metric definitions with Finance and the CRO, keep data quality high, and reconcile bookings and ARR between the CRM and Finance every month.
* **Run the forecast:** Build a forecast process the CEO, CRO and board rely on, give an independent view alongside the sales call, and improve its accuracy every quarter.
* **Define the revenue process:** Set stage definitions, MEDDPICC qualification, handoffs and a renewals pipeline that opens well before each contract ends, across all product lines.
* **Build the deal desk:** Put pricing and discount rules, quoting and approvals on a written footing with Legal and Finance, so standard deals move fast and exceptions get a quick decision.
* **Support planning and pay:** Build the capacity model behind the bookings plan, support territory and quota setting, and keep commissions accurate and paid on time.
* **Enable the sales team:** Own onboarding, playbooks and our sales hub, and make sure every product, pricing or process change lands with training and the CRM change together.

  
**Qualifications**  

* Proven experience in Revenue Operations or Sales Operations at a B2B SaaS company with an enterprise sales motion.
* A forecasting track record: you have built and run a forecast process that a CRO and CEO relied on, and can show how its accuracy improved.
* Deep hands-on CRM knowledge (Salesforce, HubSpot or similar), covering data model, automation, integrations, administration and change control.
* Strong analytical skills: advanced spreadsheet skills, plus SQL or a BI tool, and the discipline to reconcile revenue data with Finance.
* Working knowledge of enterprise deals: long sales cycles, multi-year contracts, renewals, and a qualification method such as MEDDPICC.
* Experience of quota and commission administration, pricing and discount governance, or running a deal desk.
* The credibility to partner with a CRO and the independence to challenge a forecast or a deal with evidence.
* A builder’s mindset: you are hands-on, comfortable building from the ground up, and have developed people or led a small team.

  
**Additional Information**

**Why Join BlueOptima**

* **What does success in this role generate:** Within a year, the CEO, CRO and board run the business from one set of revenue numbers and a forecast they trust. You will own a function you built, with room to grow your team and your remit into wider commercial operations leadership as BlueOptima scales.
* **Culture:** Join a global, innovative team. We support rapid career growth, providing the freedom to create your own success story in a high-performance environment.
* **Continuous Development:** We prioritize your growth through bespoke training programs and Personal Development Plans (PDPs) for every employee.
* **Impact:** Be a visible contributor to a company that is redefining how the world builds software.

The Team Lead is a hands-on role at the centre of every pilot. * Flag deviations from the test plan, and equipment or process failures, the same day they happen

* Carry out pre-trial safety checks and risk assessments for every new setup or process change
* Report and investigate near-misses and incidents in the pilot area

* Deep-dive on pilot metrics and propose clear actions and process improvements
* Stand in for the Ops Lead when needed

The person will ensure that the warehouse operates efficiently, stock records remain accurate, and all incoming and outgoing inventory movements are controlled as per brand standards.

**You should not apply if you:**

* Struggle with ownership and require constant supervision to drive tasks

**Skills Required**

* Good command over inbound, GRN, inventory control, dispatch, returns, and audit processes.
* Knowledge of SKU, batch, expiry, MRP, barcode, PO, invoice, ASN, GRN, and stock adjustment processes.
* Strong attention to detail and counting accuracy.
* Ability to identify stock discrepancies, quality issues, and process gaps.
* Strong Excel / Google Sheets / MIS reporting skills.
* Understanding of WMS, OMS, ERP, and courier systems; Vinculum knowledge preferred.
* Ability to manage third\-party manpower and ensure SOP compliance.

**What you will do:**

**1\. End\-to\-End Site Operations Management**

* Own daily warehouse / darkstore operations including inbound, putaway, storage, picking, packing, dispatch, returns, and inventory control.
* Ensure orders are processed within defined cut\-off times and SLA timelines.
* Monitor daily order volume, pending orders, aging orders, SLA breaches, and operational bottlenecks.
* Coordinate with central operations, logistics, product, inventory planning, procurement, finance, and customer support teams.
* Ensure smooth order fulfilment across B2C, marketplace, darkstore, and other ecommerce channels, wherever applicable.

**2\. SLA \& Performance Management**

* Track and improve key operational metrics, including order processing TAT, dispatch TAT, pick\-pack accuracy, inventory accuracy, manpower productivity, and order breach percentage.
* Review site performance daily through dashboards, MIS, exception reports, and pending trackers.
* Identify recurring operational issues and drive corrective actions.
* Prepare daily / weekly performance updates for leadership review.
* Highlight operational risks proactively with root cause and action plan.

**3\. Inventory Accuracy \& Stock Governance**

* Ensure accurate stock storage, bin mapping, SKU hygiene, batch tracking, expiry tracking, FEFO / FIFO adherence, and stock reconciliation.
* Conduct and supervise daily, weekly, and monthly cycle counts as per audit plan.
* Verify physical stock against system stock at SKU, batch, expiry, MRP, and bin level.
* Identify stock mismatches, short / excess quantities, wrong bin placements, missing labels, unscannable barcodes, and location errors.
* Monitor shrinkage, damaged stock, expired stock, dead stock, slow\-moving stock, and high\-value inventory.
* Ensure expired, damaged, leaked, or unsellable stock is quarantined and marked correctly.
* Maintain strict controls for high\-value, fast\-moving, fragile, and expiry\-sensitive SKUs.

**4\. Inbound Audit \& GRN Control**

* Audit incoming stock against PO, invoice, ASN, delivery challan, and system records.
* Verify SKU name, SKU code, quantity, batch number, expiry date, MRP, barcode, and packaging condition.
* Ensure received stock matches system expectations before GRN closure.
* Identify shortages, excess quantity, wrong SKUs, duplicate items, damaged products, near\-expiry stock, expired stock, leakage, tampering, or invoice mismatch.
* Validate GRN entries for accuracy and ensure all discrepancies are recorded before stock acceptance.
* Prevent unauthorized inwarding of stock without PO or required approval.
* Ensure only audited and approved stock moves to putaway.

**5\. Vendor, Transporter \& Discrepancy Management**

* Report vendor\-side and transporter\-side issues such as wrong dispatch, short supply, excess supply, damaged goods, expiry mismatch, MRP mismatch, or invoice mismatch.
* Capture proper evidence through photos, quantity records, signed discrepancy notes, and audit reports.
* Maintain inbound discrepancy logs, rejection reports, vendor issue reports, damage reports, and GRN correction records.
* Coordinate with procurement, planning, finance, and warehouse teams for discrepancy closure.
* Track vendor discrepancy closure and ensure repeated issues are escalated with data.

**6\. Putaway, Storage \& Bin Discipline**

* Ensure stock is moved from the receiving area to the correct storage / bin location within defined TAT.
* Validate correct labeling, barcode scanning, batch tagging, expiry marking, and SKU placement before storage.
* Prevent wrong putaway of unaudited or rejected stock.
* Ensure bin accuracy across racks, storage zones, pick faces, and bulk locations.
* Identify mixed SKUs, wrong bin mapping, wrong batch placement, and missing labels.
* Coordinate correction of bin\-level discrepancies with warehouse team.

**7\. Team \& Manpower Management**

* Monitor whether warehouse staff, supervisors, pickers, packers, auditors, and third\-party manpower are following brand\-defined SOPs.
* Plan manpower as per order load, sale days, campaigns, and business peaks.
* Conduct daily briefings to align teams on order priorities, pending workload, SLA risks, and process discipline.
* Track manpower productivity and identify areas of underutilization or bottleneck.
* Ensure clear shift\-wise ownership for inbound, picking, packing, dispatch, returns, and audits.

**8\. Process Compliance \& Site Audit**

* Ensure SOP adherence across inbound, storage, putaway, picking, packing, dispatch, returns, cycle count, and stock adjustment processes.
* Perform site audits in accordance with brand guidelines.
* Maintain documentation for audits, stock movements, damages, GRN, dispatches, returns, rejected stock, and stock adjustments.
* Ensure all stock adjustments are properly documented and approved as per the process.
* Support internal and external audits with required data and records.
* Ensure safety, hygiene, security, and compliance standards are followed at the site.

**9\. Returns \& Reverse Inventory Control**

* Ensure returned stock is received, audited, QC\-checked, and moved to the correct inventory status.
* Validate return discrepancies such as wrong item received, missing item, damaged item, used product, or non\-sellable return.
* Track return\-to\-sellable %, return QC TAT, and rejected return stock.
* Coordinate with customer support, logistics, and finance teams for return closure and refund\-related dependencies.

**10\. Issue Resolution \& Escalation**

* Act as the first escalation point for site\-level operational and inventory\-related issues.
* Resolve issues related to stock mismatch, GRN errors, order delays, manpower shortage, courier handover delays, return discrepancies, system discrepancies, and damaged stock.
* Prepare RCA for repeated inventory mismatches, inbound discrepancies, dispatch delays, and SOP deviations.
* Escalate critical risks proactively with data, business impact, and corrective action plan.

title: Markets Operations Risk Advisory, Managing Director
description:
**Who We Are Looking For**

We are seeking a former Operations leader who has successfully managed large, complex teams within a global capital markets environment and can leverage that experience to provide credible challenge, strategic guidance, and risk advisory support across State Street Markets.


The successful candidate will have held senior managerial positions in back\-office or post\-trade operations and will bring deep knowledge of end\-to\-end trading and financing processes. Direct exposure to Foreign Exchange, Securities Lending, Secured financing is strongly preferred. This individual will combine operational credibility with sound risk judgment and an ability to influence executives, operational leaders, and control partners across regions and functions.


The role will be based in India and co\-located with a significant concentration of Markets Operations personnel. This proximity is intended to deepen day\-to\-day engagement with operational teams, strengthen first\-line challenge, improve early identification and escalation of emerging risks, and align risk advisory more closely with operational execution.


**Why This Role Is Important to Us**

State Street Markets supports institutional clients through foreign exchange, securities lending, securitized financing and multi\-asset class trading and related capital markets activities. The scale and complexity of these businesses require a strong, forward\-looking control environment across the operational processes that support the full trade lifecycle.


As Managing Director, Markets Operations Risk Advisory, you will serve as the principal Business Risk Management advisor to Markets Operations globally. You will partner with senior Operations and business leaders to ensure material risks are understood, controls remain effective and sustainable, significant events are escalated appropriately, and operational change is implemented with the right risk and control considerations. You will also help advance a more proactive, data\-driven, and exception\-based approach to first\-line risk management.


**What You Will Be Responsible For**

As a Markets Operations Risk Advisory, Managing Director you will \-


Executive Leadership and Strategic Partnership


* Act as the principal Business Risk Management representative and senior risk advisor for Markets Operations globally.
* Advise senior business leaders on operational risk, control effectiveness, strategic change, and resiliency.
* Partner with Front Office, Operations, Technology, and control\-function leaders to identify emerging risks, challenge business and operating decisions, and strengthen controls across the trade lifecycle.
* Provide constructive and credible challenge to business decisions, transformation programs, new or changing activities, and management assessments of risk.
* Lead executive discussions concerning significant operational events, control weaknesses, remediation priorities, and emerging risk themes.
* Represent Business Risk Management in relevant risk governance forums.
* Drive consistent risk management expectations and practices across global Markets Operations locations.

Markets Operations Risk Advisory and Control Oversight


* Provide risk advisory coverage across operational processes supporting Foreign Exchange, and Financing and Portfolio Solutions businesses.
* Assess risks and controls across the end\-to\-end trade lifecycle, including pre\-trade activities supported by the Client Onboarding and Business Management function, trade capture and validation, confirmations, settlement, collateral and margin operations, reconciliations, cash processing, asset servicing, client reporting, and exception management.
* Provide risk advisory and credible challenge over client onboarding processes, including governance, operational readiness, data quality, system setup, control execution, and escalation of material risks or exceptions.
* Challenge the design, execution, and sustainability of preventive, detective, and compensating controls across critical operational workflows.
* Partner with Operations leadership to identify control gaps, manual\-process dependencies, capacity constraints, data\-quality concerns, and operational vulnerabilities before they result in material events.
* Promote scalable processes, workflow automation, data\-driven monitoring, leading indicators, and exception\-based management to reduce operational risk and human error.
* Provide risk input into operating model changes, technology implementations, process migrations, product launches, outsourcing arrangements, and other strategic initiatives.

Incident, Issue, and Remediation Management


* Promote timely identification, escalation, investigation, and governance of operational incidents, near misses, losses, and control failures.
* Provide senior challenge of impact assessments, root cause analyses, corrective actions, issue ratings, and target dates.
* Ensure remediation plans address underlying causes, deliver measurable risk reduction, and include appropriate interim or compensating controls where necessary.
* Monitor significant issues through closure and challenge whether corrective actions are sustainable and operating as intended.
* Identify cross\-business themes and use lessons learned to strengthen controls beyond the immediate event or process.

Risk Framework and Governance


* Provide oversight and challenge across first\-line risk programs, including Risk and Control Self\-Assessments, control inventories, Key Risk Indicators, operational risk events, issue management, operational resilience, third\-party risk, and risk change management.
* Use management information, risk metrics, event data, assurance results, and thematic analysis to identify areas requiring management attention.
* Lead the monthly Markets Operations Risk Steering Committee, ensuring transparent reporting, effective management challenge, and timely escalation of material risks, control performance, significant incidents, remediation progress, and emerging concerns.
* Help ensure adherence to applicable first\-line policies, standards, governance requirements, and escalation protocols.

Regulatory, Audit, and Assurance Leadership


* Lead first\-line risk advisory engagement supporting regulatory examinations, internal audits, independent assurance reviews, and control testing involving Markets Operations.
* Challenge the quality, completeness, and sustainability of management responses and remediation plans arising from findings or observations.
* Assess whether proposed corrective actions address root causes and appropriately reduce residual operational risk.
* Support ongoing examination and audit readiness, including clear evidence of ownership, governance, control execution, and sustained remediation.
* Partner with Compliance, Enterprise Risk Management, Internal Audit, Legal, and other control functions while maintaining clear first\-line accountability.

People and Organizational Leadership


* Lead, develop, and retain a high\-performing team of Business Risk Advisors and operational subject matter experts.
* Set clear priorities, standards, and accountabilities while creating an inclusive environment that encourages constructive challenge and escalation.
* Build stronger operational and product expertise across the broader Business Risk Management organization.
* Create effective partnerships across India and the global Markets organization and influence outcomes without relying solely on formal authority.

Scope of Coverage


* Businesses and products: Foreign Exchange; Securities Lending; and Portfolio Solutions.
* Operational lifecycle: Trade capture and validation; confirmations; settlement; collateral and margin; reconciliations; cash processing; asset servicing; client servicing and reporting; exceptions and break management.
* Risk disciplines: Control design and effectiveness; incident and near\-miss management; issue remediation; RCSA and KRI oversight; operational resilience; third\-party risk; change risk; regulatory, audit, and assurance support.

**What We Value**

* Deep practical knowledge of capital markets operations and the risks inherent in high\-volume, multi\-asset\-class trading and financing environments.
* Executive presence, sound judgment, and the ability to challenge constructively while sustaining trusted business partnerships.
* A proactive mindset focused on early risk identification, clear escalation, and prevention of material events.
* Strategic thinking combined with disciplined execution and close attention to detail.
* Ability to simplify complex issues, communicate clearly, and translate risk insights into practical management action.
* Demonstrated commitment to accountability, collaboration, inclusion, and continuous improvement.

**Education and Preferred Qualifications**

Required Experience


* Bachelor degree or equivalent professional experience.
* 15 or more years of experience in capital markets, securities services, investment banking operations, broker\-dealer operations, or a related financial services environment.
* Significant prior managerial experience leading back\-office, post\-trade, or other Markets Operations teams in a global organization.
* Strong understanding of operational processes, risks, controls, and dependencies across the trade lifecycle.
* Demonstrated ability to influence senior executives and partner effectively with Operations, business, Technology, Risk, Compliance, Internal Audit, and Legal stakeholders.
* Experience leading complex transformation, remediation, control enhancement, or operational excellence initiatives.

Preferred Experience
